Danger! monsters discard a random card from your hand by a card effect, which triggers Dark World monsters such as Grapha, Dragon Lord of Dark World.

Mermail monsters such as Mermail Abyssteus discard a WATER monster as a cost, which triggers the Atlantean effects that need to be sent to the GY to activate a WATER monster's effect.
The discard-cost link is all Main Deck cards.

The link runs through Xyz Monsters and Rank-Up-Magic, not Link Monsters.
